positive_vs_dominant.meaning: HairInfluences counts every positive imported LOD0 InfluenceWeights slot mapped to the bone. It is not a dominant-weight ownership count; section seams/duplicate influence mappings were not separately deduplicated by this report.
positive_vs_dominant.reason_missing: ClothAuthor preserves/skips Iron pivot/geometry refinement; historical ClothSurfaceProbe IsClothBone excludes Iron.

coordinate_conversion.reference_mode: Separate Body and Leg imported reference component spaces treated as a common unit-cm reference frame, matching the prior author reference-geometry convention. Runtime CopyPose alignment and InitialParticleX/R body-space basis are not verified here.
coordinate_conversion.shape_geometry: Existing AggGeom center/radius/length already cm; do not divide these by100. Shape uses the bone-local center and rotation, not actor CoM local geometry.
coordinate_conversion.rotation_fields: Native FTransform::ToString is Pitch,Yaw,Roll degrees, confirmed by Engine/Source/Runtime/Core/Private/Math/Transform.cpp:50-56. Quaternion conversion follows UnrealMath.cpp:448-465.
coordinate_conversion.current_shape_policy: Earlier CollisionAuthor restores source AggGeom and clamps only simulated capsule radius to min(source_radius,1cm); ClothAuthor preserves Iron. This is a saved-policy inference, not a fresh body-array/InitialParticle verification.

formulas.capsule_axis: a=center-axis*(cylinderLength/2); b=center+axis*(cylinderLength/2). FK capsule length is the straight cylinder axis length.
formulas.finite_segment_distance: min_{s,t in[0,1]} ||aIron+s*(bIron-aIron)-aPelvis-t*(bPelvis-aPelvis)||, solved with endpoint clamping.
formulas.signed_surface_gap_cm: d_axis-(radiusIron+radiusBodyPelvis); negative means overlap of these reference capsule proxies under the stated alignment.
formulas.point_phi_cm: distance(point, closest point on body pelvis capsule axis)-radiusBodyPelvis.
formulas.quaternion_pitch_yaw_roll: half-angle SP/SY/SR and CP/CY/CR; X=CR*SP*SY-SR*CP*CY; Y=-CR*SP*CY-SR*CP*SY; Z=CR*CP*SY-SR*SP*CY; W=CR*CP*CY+SR*SP*SY.

source_import_geometry_relation.verified_from_saved_policy: Iron current estimate retains source center, rotation, straight length; radius is narrowed from10.20948/10.20937cm to1cm. This makes a subset of the original capsule in the same bone-local frame and cannot establish coverage of the weighted skin.
source_import_geometry_relation.rotation_preserves_mesh_binding: No skeleton/skin weight edit is indicated by this policy, but thin capsule alignment/coverage of the actual dominant-owned vertices is unmeasured. Do not infer mesh support from the preserved shape rotation alone.

original_game_direct_export.finding: Existing narrow search found no direct source-game Iron physics export. Original-named imported PA fields are imported-project evidence; radius1/damping changes are assistant temporary values, not game-original confirmation.

uncertainties: NativeAudit numeric strings are rounded; derived digits are not full precision asset inputs.
Body and Leg reference skeleton component transforms differ; live CopyPose input may align the common pelvis to the body reference rather than the separate imported Leg reference.
Actual ImmediatePhysics body/CoM geometry transforms, InitialParticleX/R and shape-to-actor basis must be read in the upcoming native probe before treating this estimate as a runtime overlap.
No raw Iron support vertex coordinates, maximum-weight ownership/ties or per-vertex skin-vs-current-capsule distances are stored in the reviewed historical reports.
Negative capsule-proxy clearance is not penetration of the visible body triangle skin, nor an observed persistent contact/jitter cause.
Historical native cloth PASS excluded Iron and aggregate BodyContactDepth cannot identify its fresh minimum overlap.
